leads.headline: KYIV BRIDGES HIT
leads.summary: Russia fires 110+ missiles and ~400 drones overnight; ballistic missiles damage three Dnipro bridges — Podilsko-Voskresenskyi, Darnytskyi and Pivdennyi. Nine killed, 30 injured across Ukraine.
